errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва броя на автомобилите в диапазона от 0 до 3 500 000, със стъпка от 500 000, етикетирана като "Брой автомобили".
errors.evidence: The y-axis label in the figure is "Брой автомобили", but the chart title and caption indicate the figure is about the number of electric cars and their share of the total; this axis description omits that the chart is specifically for electric cars and also does not mention the displayed percentage axis/series.

The 2019 blue bar is labeled 242 966, but the generated description implies this is a value of electric cars without noting that the bar label in the figure appears as "-242 966" (a minus sign is visible before the number).

The description does not mention the secondary percentage information as a separate y-axis/scale; the figure shows orange percentage bars labeled 2,9; 10,7; 18; 21,6; 22,3 and the title explicitly references "% от общия брой".
The description does not mention that the chart contains an extraneous placeholder axis label "Axis Title" beneath the x-axis, which is visible in the figure.
